class.name: MaszynaDataPath
class.brief_description: Finds a file the game data names, whatever its letter case.
class.description: The game data is made on Windows, whose file names ignore letter case: a scenery says [code]PKP\\SN61_V2[/code] for [code]pkp/sn61_v2[/code], and 821 names on disk carry capitals. [method resolve] is the one operation every loader of the data uses.

method.name: resolve
method.description: The path of [param relative_path] under [param base_dir] as it is on disk: as authored, else its lowercase form, else each part matched against its directory's entries letter case aside. Backslashes become slashes. Returns [param relative_path] unchanged when nothing matches, for the caller's own diagnostics.
